race.comment: COSMIC EAGLE (7) made some progress last season as a 3YO, and her recent spell would have done her the world of good. She has trialled up strongly in the lead up to her return, and only a wide gate is the query. Each way. SEQUOIA (11) had no chance last start after settling back and wide here 2 weeks ago. She is better than that and is worth another chance. MICHONNE'S KATANA (13) has been taken along quietly and will be a lot stronger this season, after ending her last prep with a third as the favourite at Bathurst in June. Include in all top 4 combos. VELASTRA (10) has been freshened up since a reasonable debut effort, and she will be a quick improver. WILD YARN (12) drops in trip second up, and will don the blinkers for the first time. Keep safe.
